A '''Nechryael (elite)''' is an [[elite monster|elite version]] of the [[nechryael]]. If on a [[Slayer assignment]], an elite Nechryael is guaranteed to spawn; otherwise, elite monsters have a spawn rate of 1 in 1,000. Elite spawn rates can be further increased with the use of [[fellstalk incense stick]]s and tier 2 [[luck]]. 

==Names==
The elite versions have varying names, with a randomly generated prefix and suffix.
{{Elite names|name=Nechryael}}
